newsitem.title: FINLAND: OLVI '96 SALES ROSE 4.1 PCT, EXPORTS SOAR.
newsitem.headline: OLVI '96 SALES ROSE 4.1 PCT, EXPORTS SOAR.

text.p: Finnish brewer Olvi Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its sales volume increased 4.1 percent year-on-year in 1996 with domestic beer, soft drink and mineral water sales up 3.6 percent, and exports soaring 15.2 percent.

Olvi's sales volume rose to 89.5 million litres. It outpeformed domestic market growth in soft drink sales (Olvi +25.6 pct, branch +4.0 pct) and in mineral water sales (Olvi +16.0 pct, branch +13.1 percent).
While total Finnish beer sales fell 1.9 percent last year, Olvi said its domestic beer sales fell 9.7 percent. But Olvi's beer exports rose almost three-fold, it said, but gave no figures.
